name: ModifyDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name whose configurations you want to modify
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name
parameters.name: domain_id

fields.help_en: The HTTPS listening ports. The format is \[**port1,port2,...**]
fields.help_zh: HTTPS协议的监听端口，使用[**port1,port2,……**]格式
fields.name: https_ports

fields.help_en: The HTTP listening ports. The format is \[**port1,port2,...**]
fields.help_zh: HTTP协议的监听端口，使用[**port1,port2,……**]格式
fields.name: http_ports

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled. This parameter is available only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **true**: HTTP/2 is enabled.

- **false** (default): HTTP/2 is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启HTTP2。

- **false**（默认）：表示不开启HTTP2
fields.name: http2_enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the certificate
fields.help_zh: 要添加的证书的ID
fields.name: cert_id

fields.help_en: Indicates whether SM certificates are enabled
fields.help_zh: 是否开启国密证书
fields.name: sm2_enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the SM certificate. This parameter is required only when SM2Enabled is set to true
fields.help_zh: 要添加的国密证书的ID。仅SM2Enable取值为true时，使用该参数
fields.name: sm2_cert_id

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether access is allowed only from SM clients. This parameter is available only when SM2Enabled is set to true. Valid values:

- true: Only SM clients can access the website.

- false: Both SM and non-SM clients can access the website
fields.help_zh:
是否仅客端访问。仅SM2Enable取值为true时，使用该参数。

- true：仅国密客户端才可以访问。

- false：国密和非国密均可以访问
fields.name: sm2_access_only

fields.help_en:
The TLS version. This parameter is available only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **tlsv1**

- **tlsv1.1**

- **tlsv1.2**
fields.help_zh:
要添加的TLS版本。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **tlsv1**

- **tlsv1.1**

- **tlsv1.2**
fields.name: tls_version

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is supported. This parameter is available only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **true**: TLS 1.3 is supported.

- **false**: TLS 1.3 is not supported
fields.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

- **false**：表示不支持TLS1.3版本
fields.name: enable_tlsv3

fields.help_en:
The type of the cipher suite. This parameter is available only when **HttpsPorts** is not empty, which indicates that the domain uses HTTPS. Valid values:

- **1**: all cipher suites.

- **2**: strong cipher suites. You can select this value only when you set **TLSVersion** to **tlsv1.2**.

- **99**: custom cipher suites
fields.help_zh:
要添加的加密套件类型。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **1**：表示添加全部加密套件。

- **2**：表示添加强加密套件。仅**TLSVersion**取值为**tlsv1.2**时，可选择该取值。

- **99**：表示添加自定义加密套件
fields.name: cipher_suite

fields.help_en: The custom cipher suites. This parameter is available only when you set **CipherSuite** to **99**
fields.help_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件。仅**CipherSuite**配置为**99**时，使用该参数
fields.name: custom_ciphers

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether forced HTTPS redirection is enabled. This parameter is available only when the domain uses HTTPS but not HTTP. Valid values:

- **true**: Forced HTTPS redirection is enabled.

- **false**: Forced HTTPS redirection is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTPS的强制跳转。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议），且**HttpPorts**取值为空（表示域名未使用HTTP协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启HTTPS的强制跳转。

- **false**：表示不开启HTTPS的强制跳转
fields.name: focus_https

fields.help_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the real IP address of a client. Valid values:

- **0** (default): WAF obtains the client IP address from the TCP connection. This option is suitable if no Layer 7 proxies are deployed in front of WAF.

- **1**: WAF obtains the client IP address from the first value of the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header.

- **2**: WAF obtains the client IP address from a custom header field
fields.help_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

- **0**（默认）：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

- **1**：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

- **2**：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP
fields.name: xff_header_mode

fields.help_en:
The custom header fields that are used to obtain the client IP address. The format is \[**"header1","header2",...**].

> This parameter is required only when you set **XffHeaderMode** to 2
fields.help_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用[**"header1","header2",……**]格式表示。

> 仅在**XffHeaderMode**取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数
fields.name: xff_headers

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is enabled. Valid values:

- **true**: IPv6 is enabled.

- **false** (default): IPv6 is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6。取值：

- **true**：表示开启IPv6。

- **false**（默认）：表示不开启IPv6
fields.name: ipv6_enabled

fields.help_en:
The type of the protection resource. Valid values:

- **share** (default): a shared cluster.

- **gslb**: a shared cluster with global server load balancing
fields.help_zh:
要使用的防护资源类型。取值：

- **share**（默认）：表示使用共享集群。

- **gslb**：表示使用共享集群智能负载均衡
fields.name: protection_resource

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether an exclusive IP address is enabled. This parameter is available only when you set **IPv6Enabled** to false and **ProtectionResource** to **share**. Valid values:

- **true**: An exclusive IP address is enabled.

- **false** (default): An exclusive IP address is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启独享IP。仅**IPv6Enabled**取值为false（表示不开启IPv6），且**ProtectionResource**取值为**share**时（表示使用共享集群）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启独享IP。

- **false**（默认）：表示不开启独享IP
fields.name: exclusive_ip

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether subdomains are included in the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) policy. Valid values:

- **true**: Subdomains are included.

- **false**: Subdomains are not included
fields.help_zh:
HSTS是否包含子域名。取值：

- **true**：表示开启。

- **false**：表示不开启
fields.name: hsts_include_sub_domain

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether HSTS preload is enabled. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true: HSTS preload is enabled.

- false: HSTS preload is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
- true：开启。
- false：关闭
fields.name: hsts_preload

fields.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of the HSTS policy. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: HSTS过期时间，单位是秒
fields.name: hsts_max_age

fields.help_en:
The IP addresses or domain names of the origin server. You can specify only one type of address. If you specify a domain name, only IPv4 is supported. IPv6 is not supported.

- IP addresses: The format is \[**"ip1","ip2",...**]. You can specify up to 20 IP addresses.

- Domain names: The format is \[**"domain"**]. You can specify up to 20 domain names
fields.help_zh:
域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名。您只能选择设置源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名中的一种，回源地址为域名时，只支持IPv4，暂不支持IPv6：

- 设置源站服务器IP时，使用[**"ip1","ip2",……**]格式表示。最多支持添加20个IP。

- 设置服务器回源域名时，使用[**"domain"**]格式表示。最多支持添加20个域名地址
fields.name: backends

fields.help_en:
The load balancing algorithm for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

- **iphash**: the IP hash algorithm.

- **roundRobin**: the round-robin algorithm.

- **leastTime**: the least time algorithm. This value is available only when you set **ProtectionResource** to **gslb**
fields.help_zh:
回源时采用的负载均衡算法。取值：

- **iphash**：表示IP Hash算法。

- **roundRobin**：表示轮询算法。

- **leastTime**：表示Least Time算法。仅**ProtectionResource**取值为**gslb**（表示防护资源类型使用共享集群智能负载均衡）时，可选择该取值
fields.name: loadbalance

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled. This parameter is available only when you specify **HttpsPorts**. Valid values:

- **true**: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is enabled.

- **false**: Forced HTTP back-to-origin is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启强制HTTP回源。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启强制HTTP回源。
- **false**：表示不开启强制HTTP回源
fields.name: focus_http_backend

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether back-to-origin Server Name Indication (SNI) is enabled. This parameter is available only when you specify **HttpsPorts**. Valid values:

- **true**: Back-to-origin SNI is enabled.

- **false** (default): Back-to-origin SNI is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启回源SNI。仅**HttpsPorts**取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

- **true**：表示开启回源SNI。
- **false**（默认）：表示不开启回源SNI
fields.name: sni_enabled

fields.help_en:
The value of the custom SNI field. If you do not set this parameter, the value of the **Host** field from the request header is used by default. You typically do not need to set this parameter unless your business requires a custom SNI value for back-to-origin requests.

> This parameter is available only when you set **SniEnabled** to true
fields.help_zh:
设置自定义SNI扩展字段的值。如果不设置该参数，则默认使用请求头中**Host**字段的值作为SNI扩展字段的值。
一般情况无需自定义SNI，除非您的业务有特殊配置要求，希望WAF在回源请求中使用与实际请求Host不一致的SNI（即此处设置的自定义SNI）。

> 仅在**SniEnalbed**取值为xxx（表示自定义回源SNI）时，需要设置该参数
fields.name: sni_host

element_fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the custom header field
element_fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段设定的值
element_fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The custom header fields and their values for traffic marking.

WAF adds these fields and values to the request headers when traffic passes through WAF. This helps backend services identify and collect statistics on WAF-processed traffic
fields.help_zh:
域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量。

通过指定自定义请求头部字段和对应的值，当域名的访问流量经过WAF时，WAF自动在请求头部中添加所设定的自定义字段值作为流量标记，便于后端服务统计相关信息
fields.name: request_headers

fields.help_en: The connection timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh:
连接超时时长。单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：5
fields.name: connect_timeout

fields.help_en: The read timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 120
fields.help_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：120
fields.name: read_timeout

fields.help_en: The write timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 120
fields.help_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：120
fields.name: write_timeout

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether public cloud disaster recovery is enabled. Valid values:

- **true**: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

- **false** (default): Public cloud disaster recovery is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

- **true**：表示开启公共云容灾。

- **false**（默认）：表示不开启公共云容灾
fields.name: cname_enabled

fields.help_en:
The forwarding rules for a hybrid cloud deployment. This parameter is a string that contains a JSON array. Each element in the array is a struct that contains the following fields:

- **rs**: an array of strings. The back-to-origin IP addresses or CNAMEs.

- **backupRs**: an array of strings. The backup back-to-origin IP addresses or CNAMEs. This field is required. If you do not want to specify backup addresses, set it to \[].

- **location**: a string. The name of the protection node.

- **locationId**: a long integer. The ID of the protection node
fields.help_zh:
混合云转发规则。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：
- **rs**：Array类型 | 表示回源IP地址或者回源CNAME列表

- **backupRs**：Array类型 | 表示回源备用IP地址或者回源CNAME列表，必填，[]表示不设置

- **location**：String类型 | 表示防护节点名称

- **locationId**：Long类型 | 表示防护节点ID
fields.name: routing_rules

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether persistent connections are enabled. Valid values:

- **true** (default): Persistent connections are enabled.

- **false**: Persistent connections are disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示保持长连接。

- **false**：表示不保持长连接
fields.name: keepalive

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether forwarding requests to the origin server are retried when the requests fail. Valid values:

- **true** (default): Requests are retried.

- **false**: Requests are not retried
fields.help_zh:
WAF回源失败时，是否重试。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示重试。
- **false**：表示不重试
fields.name: retry

fields.help_en:
The number of requests that can be reused in a persistent connection. Valid values: 60 to 1000. Default value: 1000.

> This parameter is available only when you enable persistent connections
fields.help_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，默认值：1000，单位：个。

> 开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接
fields.name: keepalive_requests

fields.help_en:
The idle timeout for a persistent connection. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 15.

> This parameter specifies the amount of time that an idle persistent connection can remain open
fields.help_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：1~60，默认15，单位：秒。

> 复用的长连接空闲多少长后释放
fields.name: keepalive_timeout

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the X-Forwarded-Proto header is used to pass the protocol used by WAF to the origin server. Valid values:

- **true** (default): The WAF protocol is passed.

- **false**: The WAF protocol is not passed
fields.help_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto传递WAF的协议。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

- **false**：表示不传递WAF的协议
fields.name: xff_proto

fields.help_en: The IP addresses or domain names of the backup origin server
fields.help_zh: 域名对应的备用源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名
fields.name: backup_backends

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether WAF is allowed to overwrite the X-Client-IP header. Valid values:

- **true** (default): WAF is allowed to overwrite the header.

- **false**: WAF is not allowed to overwrite the header
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖X-Client-IP。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

- **false**：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: x_client_ip

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether WAF is allowed to overwrite the X-True-IP header. Valid values:

- **true** (default): WAF is allowed to overwrite the header.

- **false**: WAF is not allowed to overwrite the header
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖X-True-IP。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

- **false**：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: x_true_ip

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether WAF is allowed to overwrite the Web-Server-Type header. Valid values:

- **true** (default): WAF is allowed to overwrite the header.

- **false**: WAF is not allowed to overwrite the header
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖Web-Server-Type。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

- **false**：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: web_server_type

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether WAF is allowed to overwrite the WL-Proxy-Client-IP header. Valid values:

- **true** (default): WAF is allowed to overwrite the header.

- **false**: WAF is not allowed to overwrite the header
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖WL-Proxy-Client-IP。取值：

- **true**（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

- **false**：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: wl_proxy_client_ip

fields.help_en:
The maximum size of a request body. Unit: GB. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2.

> This parameter is supported only by the WAF Ultimate edition
fields.help_zh:
最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。
> 仅旗舰版支持
fields.name: max_body_size

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

- **true**: HTTP/2 is enabled for back-to-origin requests.

- **false**: HTTP/2 is disabled for back-to-origin requests
fields.help_zh:
HTTP2回源。取值：

- **true**：表示开启HTTP2回源。

- **false**：表示不开启HTTP2回源
fields.name: http2_origin

fields.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 back-to-origin requests. Valid values: 1 to 512. Default value: 2
fields.help_zh: HTTP2回源最大并发数。取值范围：1-512，默认值：2，单位：个
fields.name: http2_origin_max_concurrency

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the Proxy Protocol is enabled to preserve client IP addresses.

- **true**: The Proxy Protocol is enabled. If you select this option, you can view the client IP address on the origin server.

- **false**: The Proxy Protocol is disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

- **true**：开启了保持客户端源IP功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始IP地址。

- **false**：未开启保持客户端源IP功能
fields.name: proxy_protocol

element_fields.help_en: The port of the origin server
element_fields.name: backend_port

element_fields.help_en:
The protocol of the listening port. Valid values:

- **http**: HTTP.

- **https**: HTTPS
element_fields.help_zh:
监听端口的协议。取值：

- **http**：表示监听端口的协议为HTTP。
